meta.name: keyword-research
meta.description: Keyword research from a seed topic — ideas, real Google volume/CPC, intent, difficulty, clustered into a plan. Use when asked to "find keywords", "keyword research for X", "what should I rank for", or "build a keyword plan".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 挖出有真实搜索量的关键词,按意图分组排成一份可落地的排名计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让文章或产品页被搜到,却不知道该从哪个词下手。
copy.tagline_en: Find keywords with real search volume, grouped by intent into a ranking plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your pages found in search but don't know which terms to target.

howto.what: 从种子词或网址扩展出约 200 个关键词,拉取 Google Ads 真实月搜索量、竞争度、CPC 与趋势,补充搜索意图和难度,按意图聚成内容集群,输出关键词表和排序后的执行计划。
howto.when: 当你要求「找关键词」「为 X 做关键词研究」等,或需要一份关键词规划时触发;使用前需装好免费的 Ryze MCP 连接器。

say.text: 帮我就「露营装备」找关键词,并给出月搜索量和 CPC。
say.note: 先扩展关键词,再拉取 Google Ads 指标。

say.text: 给我一份关键词规划:哪些集群先做,理由是什么?
say.note: 输出按量级和可赢度排序的计划。

say.text: 看看我的网站现在已经在哪些词上有排名。
say.note: 用 Search Console 数据标出已有排名的词。

howto.what_en: From a seed keyword or URL, Claude expands to ~200 ideas, pulls real Google Ads monthly volume, competition, CPC and 12-month trend, adds intent and difficulty, clusters by intent, and outputs keyword tables plus a ranked plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find keywords, do keyword research for X, or build a keyword plan. Requires the free Ryze MCP connector to be set up first.

say_en.text: Find keywords for 'camping gear' with monthly volume and CPC.
say_en.note: Expands ideas first, then pulls Google Ads metrics.

say_en.text: Build me a keyword plan — which clusters should I do first and why?
say_en.note: Returns a plan ranked by volume and winnability.

say_en.text: What keywords does my site already rank for?
say_en.note: Uses Search Console data to flag existing positions.
